status: READINESS ONLY. Not executed. No fit, no rollout, no environment, no critic, no PPO, no new collection, no candidate actor, no j18_runs, no sealed seed.

objective.one_sentence: produce ONE candidate 35D actor that corrects J8's behaviour on cell B in OUTPUT/ACTION space while provably preserving its behaviour everywhere it already works.
objective.parent: J8, immutable, pinned by actual byte hash
objective.what_is_trained: the entire mean network: pi.0.0.weight, pi.0.0.bias, pi.0.2.weight, pi.0.2.bias, and ROWS 0:2 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias
objective.what_is_frozen: the log-std, which is ROWS 2:4 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias, held byte-identical to J8. The actor has no separate log-std key: its head emits four values, two means and two log-stds, so both the freeze and its gate are expressed as a row slice.
objective.what_is_excluded: the critic. J8 carries no value-function key and none is created.
objective.why_this_is_not_a_generic_aggregate_refi: the loss constrains the network's OUTPUT on four named, disjoint state sets, two of which are preservation anchors labelled with J8's own outputs. J15R1 failed with only a PARAMETER-space anchor at weight 0.01 and no output-space constraint; J17 measured that its nominal anchor block was self-distilled from the parent and therefore contributed no gradient at initialisation (squared error 5.63e-10). Blocks C and D are the structural answer to that finding.

lineage.operational: August V26 imitation -> J2 35D -> J8 -> this constrained B-only incremental update
lineage.july: methodological source only. No July artefact enters the lineage.

pinned_inputs.note: the parent is bound by the ACTUAL BYTES of module_state.pkl. The J8 leaf sidecar manifest is stale and is never read as an identity source; the overlay records this and proves, documentarily and empirically, that these bytes are the actor that produced the A-F 5/6 rollouts.

loss.form: L(theta) = w_A * MSE_A(theta) + w_B * MSE_B(theta) + w_C * MSE_C(theta) + w_D * MSE_D(theta)
loss.per_block_reduction: mean over that block's own rows and over the two action dimensions

weights.w_D: the gridded preservation weight lambda, the same value as w_C

loss.why_w_C_equals_w_D: C and D are both preservation anchors and are held at one common strength so the grid keeps a single preservation axis. Splitting them would double the grid without a measurement motivating the split.

candidate_grid.no_adaptive_retry: no candidate is ever re-run, re-seeded or re-tuned in response to its own result. The grid is fixed before execution and executed exactly once.
candidate_grid.enumeration_rule: nested loops in the axis order declared above, outermost first: for lambda in [1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0]: for beta in [1.0, 5.0]: for lr in [1e-05, 5e-05]. The resulting position is the candidate_index, 0 through 15.

why_these_values.lambda: spans a factor of 30 around parity. Block B holds 14 rows against 3707 preservation rows, so with per-block means the preservation pressure is set entirely by lambda, not by row counts. The measured baseline gives no reason to prefer one value, so the range is spanned rather than guessed.
why_these_values.beta: 1.0 is parity with the teacher block; 5.0 upweights the 14-row on-policy block, which is the block the phase exists to fix.
why_these_values.learning_rate: 5e-05 is the frozen JULY_HP value used by J8, J11 and J15R1 and is carried for continuity; 1e-05 is the gentler alternative appropriate to an incremental update from a working parent. No third value is introduced.

fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.seed_note: 123 is the established fit seed. Seeds 126, 127 and 128 remain sealed and are not read, generated or used.
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.shuffling: deterministic, derived from the seed alone
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.logstd_freeze_method: PROJECTION on a ROW SLICE. After every optimizer step, rows 2:4 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias are overwritten with J8's values. They are not merely excluded from the optimizer, so no update can leak into them, and because the freeze is a slice of a trained tensor rather than a separate parameter, exclusion alone would not have worked at all. The Adam moment buffers for the head are polluted and then discarded, as in J11 and J15R1.
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.clock_columns: columns 0 and 1 of the first layer are hard-zeroed after every optimizer step and again at save
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.encoder_aliases: the four pi_encoder.* aliases are rebuilt as bit-identical copies of the trained pi.* tensors at save
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.physical_scales: absorbed into layer 1 at save, so the committed actor consumes RAW observations, as in J11 and J15R1
fit_protocol_fixed_outside_the_grid.why_no_validation_split: blocks C and D are anchors, not a generalisation target, so a random split of them measures nothing meaningful, and block B holds 14 rows and cannot be split. Instead the composite objective is evaluated on the FULL blocks at every epoch. This is disclosed rather than hidden: it means the within-run checkpoint choice is not an out-of-sample estimate, and the acceptance decision therefore rests on the preregistered gates below and, ultimately, on closed-loop requalification.

checkpoint_selection_within_a_run.rule: keep the epoch with the lowest composite objective L evaluated on the full blocks; ties broken by the EARLIEST epoch

thresholds.derivation_principle: every numeric threshold below is derived from a MEASURED baseline quantity recorded in v26c_j18_dataset_manifest.json. None is chosen by preference.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: preservation_max_drift_C
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: max absolute difference between the candidate's mean output and block C's labels, over all 2497 rows and both actions, <= 0.005
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: 2.91x below 0.014557, the smallest maximum perturbation among the stochastic cells J8 actually PASSED (cell E); and below the median one-step command change on both actions (knee 0.011918, ankle 0.007493).

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: preservation_max_drift_D
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: the same bound on block D, over all 1210 rows and both actions

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: preservation_bias_C
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: absolute SIGNED MEAN drift, computed per action over block C, <= 0.0014557
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: one tenth of 0.014557, the smallest tolerated perturbation. The tenth is not decoration: the perturbation J8 demonstrably absorbed was ZERO-MEAN and step-varying, whereas a weight drift is systematic and persistent, so that evidence does not cover a bias of the same magnitude and the bias is held an order of magnitude tighter.
hard_gates_all_must_pass.why_a_separate_bias_gate: J17 measured that the J16 failure involved the knee being systematically UNDER-COMMANDED before the breach. A bounded worst case does not exclude a small persistent bias, and a persistent bias is the failure mode already observed.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: preservation_bias_D
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: the same bound on block D

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: on_policy_improvement_B
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: exactly one half of the measured baseline MSE_B = 0.1909311190718203. The runner DERIVES this value as BASELINE_MSE_B / 2.0 rather than storing a rounded literal, so the threshold cannot drift away from the measurement it claims. Block B is the reason the phase exists; a candidate that does not at least halve the on-policy error has not done the job.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: teacher_non_regression_A
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: the measured baseline MSE_A itself, at full double precision. Block A is not required to improve, but it must not get worse.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: logstd_frozen_and_state_independent
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: rows 2:4 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias are byte-identical to J8's, AND the log-std rows of pi.1.weight remain exactly zero
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: structural invariant, not a measured quantity
hard_gates_all_must_pass.why_this_is_expressed_as_a_slice: the actor has NO separate log-std key. The output head emits four values, [mean_knee, mean_ankle, logstd_knee, logstd_ankle], so the log-std is rows 2:4 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias. An earlier draft of the runner searched for a key whose name contained 'logstd', found nothing, and would therefore have made this gate VACUOUSLY TRUE. The readiness test suite caught that before any execution. The gate now compares the actual slice and additionally requires the log-std weight rows to stay exactly zero, so the log-std cannot silently become state-dependent.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: no_critic
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: the candidate's key set contains no value-function or critic key

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: clock_columns_zero
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: first-layer weight columns 0 and 1 are exactly zero

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: key_set_identical
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: the candidate's key set is identical to J8's ten keys, with identical shapes
hard_gates_all_must_pass.derivation: structural invariant. No widening, no separate 25D actor, no contralateral feature, 35D throughout.

hard_gates_all_must_pass.name: finiteness
hard_gates_all_must_pass.statement: every tensor of the candidate and every reported metric is finite

keys_in_order.why: the on-policy block is the phase's target
least disturbance to what already works
the grid index is unique, so the order is TOTAL and no tie can remain unresolved

ranking_applied_only_to_candidates_that_.selected_candidate: the first candidate under this ordering. Exactly one candidate is selected.

fail_closed_rule.if_no_candidate_passes_every_hard_gate: the phase FAILS. No candidate is promoted, no threshold is relaxed, no axis value is added, no candidate is re-run. The failure is reported with all sixteen candidates' measured metrics preserved, and the next step returns to the architect.

what_this_phase_can_and_cannot_establish.can: that a candidate improves the on-policy block by at least half while its output stays within a measured drift budget on 3707 preservation states.
what_this_phase_can_and_cannot_establish.cannot: that the candidate passes closed loop. J17 measured this directly: J15R1 improved on its corrective rows offline and then scored 0/6 in closed loop, because a bit-identical observation at step 1 diverged into a different trajectory. Offline gates SHORTLIST; they do not certify.
what_this_phase_can_and_cannot_establish.consequence: the binding verdict on any candidate produced here is a later closed-loop A-F requalification, which this phase does not perform and does not preauthorise.
what_this_phase_can_and_cannot_establish.epistemic_labels: every claim in the eventual execution report must be labelled evidence, inference or hypothesis to be tested. A correlation is never to be called a cause.

artefacts_this_phase_will_produce_when_a.preflight_output: written to stdout and to a preflight JSON OUTSIDE j18_runs; --preflight-only writes no actor and creates no leaf
artefacts_this_phase_will_produce_when_a.execution_leaf: j18_runs/... , created ONLY under an explicit architect GO, content-addressed and no-clobber, with a born-invalid TECHNICAL_INVALID leaf removed only as the last write after post-commit verification
